title: Untitled (Targets and Discs) 1
description: Mixed collage on paper features concentric target rings in black-and-white and red-and-white, flanked by two CD-R discs and a row of small bullseye circles. Tape borders the edges; handwritten inscriptions including 'Allison' and 'XXXIII' appear along the lower margin.
composition: layered targets and discs on taped paper
